one_liner: All-in-one docs platform combining pages, tables/databases, automations, and integrations.
access_notes: Any user can generate API tokens in account settings; API is available to all users free of charge on free and paid workspaces.
blocker_notes: Coda imposes a document-size caveat: docs larger than ~125 MB may not be able to access the API, which can constrain some use cases.

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
To use the API, you’ll first need an API token… Go to docs.superhuman.com/account… Click the Generate API token button… Choose a permission level.
Server URL: https://coda.io/apis/mcp… When connecting the Coda MCP via OAuth 2 (as with ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor)…
On all plan types, docs larger than 125 MB* may not be able to access the Coda API.

_trail.quote: "Give your connector a name, then enter the following URL into the Remote MCP Server URL field: https://coda.io/apis/mcp"

_reconciled.reason: Buildability was set to ready_with_caveats but blocker was none; set blocker to other and noted the 125 MB doc-size API caveat to align with evidence and access=self_serve_free.
